title: Standards registry
intent: One list of every standard known to this platform, whether or not the platform uses it, so the gap between known and aligned is visible. Origin owner 2026-09-08: keep a standards file that tracks which standards align with our tool and which do not, and keep improving it. Taken further here (proposed): each row is computed against the knowledge base, the skill contracts and the examples, so the alignment column is measured rather than asserted.

ladder.contract: a skill contract names the standard (E-standard entity, version, sources), so the platform claims it
ladder.researched: research records exist in kb/research.jsonl and no skill contract names it
ladder.known: listed here only, no research record yet: a gap to research, never to invent

positions.adopt: the platform should name it in a contract
positions.hold: named where it is, no wider use planned
positions.watch: too early or too contested to name, re-check at a phase boundary
positions.decline: considered and not adopted, with the reason

no_open_standard.note: case sets, baselines and verdicts have tools (Inspect and similar) but no specification; the contract is the platform's own and is marked proposed
checkpoints, resume points and compensation are a pattern; no body publishes a wire or document format
memory items are vendor-specific everywhere; the platform stores opaque records at a pinned snapshot and defers nothing

no_open_standard.area: cell lifecycle beyond start and stop
no_open_standard.note: pause, resume, snapshot and fork have no standard verb set; the ontology's fourteen verbs are the platform's own
